rationale: After reaching a high of $10.12 (+1.10% MFE, or 2.5x the 5-minute ATR), UPWK has round-tripped its entire gain back to the $10.01 entry price and broken below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($10.05) alongside a softening broader market (SPY down from +0.52% at entry to +0.31%). Exiting near breakeven protects capital now that short-term momentum has failed to hold above the $10.05–$10.10 area.
